question: Which is the largest planet of the solar system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jupiter.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jupiter **is the** largest planet** of the solar system with a diameter of about **86,881 miles**, which is more than **11 times** the** diameter of Earth.**
 
• It is also the fifth planet from the sun</strong&
